cl.x: Provide SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2026, Version 01.01).

SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 8 Geotextile is a drainage and protection sheet produced from high density polyethylene (HDPE) with dimples 8 mm deep and a filtration layer of geotextile (PP) bonded on the top.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: As a drainage and protection sheet for preformed sheet membrane waterproofing systems, waterproofing mortars and coatings, and Sika® White Box concept for waterproofing basements.
s: Planter Boxes
Retaining Walls
Basement walls
Roof Tops with decorative gravel
